description: This source file provides utility functions for resolving and spawning 'pnpm' package manager commands across different platforms, with special handling for Windows environments. It includes functions to identify pnpm executable paths, escape command arguments safely, build command line strings, and spawn subprocesses to run pnpm commands.

methods.name: isPnpmExecPath
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a pnpm executable or script.

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes command-line arguments for Windows cmd.exe, replacing unsafe characters.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Constructs a command line string for cmd.exe with proper escaping.

methods.name: resolvePnpmRunner
methods.description: Determines the correct command and arguments to run pnpm based on the environment and parameters.

methods.name: createPnpmRunnerSpawnSpec
methods.description: Creates a spawn specification object with command, args, and options for running pnpm.

methods.name: spawnPnpmRunner
methods.description: Spawns a subprocess to execute the pnpm command with the specified parameters.
